title: Craftable Creakings
description: This simple data pack allows one to craft a creaking egg in survival! Now you can build redstone machines that activate simply by looking at a creaking that doesn't despawn! (The creaking will not despawn if named)
body:
**Description**
The purpose of this datapack is to allow for a creaking to be spawned in survival that does not despawn when named! The recipe consists of 2 pale oak logs, 4 armadillo scutes, a creaking heart, an orange dye, and a gray dye. 


**Instructions** 
 1. Craft the Creaking
 2. Spawn Creaking
3.  3. Rename the Creaking
And BOOM you now have a creaking that will not despawn in survival!
